HOW AN ENGAGEMENT RUNS

Kick-off to Q&A,
the same shape every time.

Every engagement follows five stages. The audit takes two weeks, the threat model and DPIA three or four, the signing infrastructure four or six. Weekly written status lands on Fridays, and the Q&A window after delivery is included in the fee.

STAGE 1

Discovery call

30 minutes, free, no sales script. We ask about your product and exposure; you ask about the engagement. If the fit is wrong you leave with better questions to ask elsewhere.

STAGE 2

NDA and kick-off

A standard mutual NDA is signed within 24 hours, or your template is turned around in two business days. The 90-minute kick-off with your engineering, product and legal leads confirms scope and access.

STAGE 3

Discovery and drafting

We read what exists (documentation, threat model, SBOM state, release process), map it against the regulation and draft the deliverables. Workshops or weekly working sessions keep your team in the loop.

STAGE 4

Review and delivery

VF's retained conformance consultant or Malta advocate reviews the set. Documents arrive as PDF plus editable markdown; infrastructure arrives as running code on your stack, with a presentation or knowledge-transfer session.

STAGE 5

Q&A window

Four to eight weeks of written follow-up after delivery, depending on the engagement and tier. Typical volume is 5 to 15 questions. Follow-on work is quoted separately if you want us to continue.

Team

One VF Empire senior engineer on every engagement, plus a retained CRA conformance consultant (Services 01 and 03) or a retained Malta advocate (Service 02). The Extended tier of Service 02 adds a second review by a retained data-protection auditor.

Payment

Invoiced in EUR by VF Empire Corp Ltd (Malta, VAT MT 2686-9431) or by Noirda GmbH in Germany if you need a German counterparty. Services 01 and 02: 50% at kick-off, 50% at delivery. Service 03: 40% at kick-off, 30% mid-engagement, 30% at delivery. SEPA transfer.

Language

English is the primary drafting language. German and French are available on request for the audit; German, French, Italian and Maltese translations of the threat model and DPIA are quoted separately at roughly €2 000 to €4 000 per document per language.

Confidentiality

The deliverable is yours. VF publishes nothing unless you ask. Some clients later publish the threat model as a trust signal, as VF does for its own products; that is a follow-on advisory conversation outside the default engagement.

COMMON QUESTIONS

What most first calls ask.

Which engagement should we start with?

Start with the CRA Readiness Audit if you do not yet know where your product stands against Annex I and Annex II; it produces the gap analysis and the remediation roadmap. Engage the threat model and DPIA when you know you need the documents themselves. Commission the signing infrastructure when signed updates and SBOMs are the gap you cannot close in-house.

Are the fees fixed, and what do they include?

Yes. Each engagement has a Standard and an Extended tier with a fixed EUR fee: €12 000 or €18 000 for the audit, €18 000 or €30 000 for the threat model and DPIA, €25 000 or €40 000 for the signing infrastructure. The fee includes engineering time, retained consultant or advocate time, deliverable production and the post-delivery Q&A window. There is no hourly billing.

Does the Cyber Resilience Act apply to a non-EU manufacturer or a B2B-only product?

Yes to both. CRA applies to products placed on the EU market regardless of manufacturer origin or buyer type. Non-EU manufacturers establish an EU authorised representative or work through an importer, and the technical file and Declaration of Conformity requirements apply identically. B2B industrial products are more often Class II, which can require a Notified Body rather than self-attestation.

We already have ISO 27001 or SOC 2. Do we still need this?

Yes. Those frameworks address information-security management for your organisation. The CRA addresses the product placed on the market: its vulnerability handling, its SBOM and its security-support lifecycle. GDPR Article 35 addresses the processing operation. The frameworks complement CRA and GDPR obligations without replacing them.

Can you sign an NDA before the discovery call?

Yes. VF signs a standard mutual NDA within 24 hours of your request, or reviews and returns your own template within two business days. Write to services@vfempire.com and ask for the NDA first; the call is booked once it is in place.

Who does the work, and where is VF Empire based?

A VF Empire senior engineer leads every engagement, with a retained CRA conformance consultant or Malta advocate reviewing the deliverables before they ship. VF Empire Corp Ltd is incorporated in Malta (C 94160), inside the EU, with a German network company, Noirda GmbH, available as an invoicing counterparty. All desks are on the contact page.
